description: Find items in the reader's catalogue of AI tools, repos, videos and guides that people shared in chats. Call it before choosing a tool for a task, since someone may already have vetted one; once you have an id and need the whole card, use driftnet_get_item instead. query is matched word by word (every word must appear) against names, summaries, tags, URLs, folder names, the reader's notes and the chat text a link was shared with, so 'pdf markdown' finds 'Convert PDF to Markdown' (it also matches by meaning when the reader turned that on); omit it to browse. If nothing matches, misspelt words are corrected and corrected says what was searched instead. days switches the order to newest first, which is how to ask what's new. view=trash is how to find an id to restore with driftnet_update_item; view=inbox adds each item's suggested folders. folder also covers its sub-folders. Dead, archived or stale links are marked in health. Results come best first (must-see, then newest) and never include down-voted or prompt-injection-flagged items. There is no paging: when limit cuts results off, narrow with query, folder, kind or days.

days.description: Only items added in the last N days, 1–90, newest first; omit for any time

folder.description: Folder id from driftnet_list_folders, e.g. 'coding'; includes its sub-folders. Omit for every folder

kind.description: Only this kind of link, e.g. 'repo'; omit for all kinds

min_worth.description: Rating floor, skip < low < normal < must-see; default 'normal'

query.description: Free text, 1–200 chars, e.g. 'pdf to markdown' or a tool name; omit to list without filtering

view.description: all (default), inbox, favorites, trash, or needs_review (dead, archived or stale links)

name: driftnet_search_items
title: Search the catalogue
